messages.ahead: The generation asked for is ahead of the one held
messages.behind: No generation as new as the one asked for is held yet
messages.beyond_allowance: The change asks for more than the allowance gives
messages.beyond_host: The host cannot give what is asked
messages.beyond_limit: The statement goes past a limit of the database
messages.beyond_range: A value is beyond the range its column holds
messages.beyond_window: The moment asked for is outside the window kept
messages.call_cycle: The calls the change declares form a cycle
messages.calls_unmatched: A call the change declares matches no export
messages.constraint: The statement breaks a constraint of the database
messages.denied: The call carries no credential, or one that does not allow it
messages.depended_on: Something else depends on what the change removes
messages.expectation_failed: What is held is not what the call expected
messages.extension_invalid: The extension named is not valid here
messages.gap: The frames asked for are no longer all held
messages.hash_mismatch: What was fetched does not match its hash
messages.held: The lease is held by another until it ends
messages.invalid: The input is well formed but not valid
messages.malformed: The call is not as its interface writes it
messages.no_export: No export of that name is deployed
messages.no_kind: No kind of that name exists
messages.no_sandbox: No host offers the sandbox asked for
messages.not_a_bucket: No bucket of that name exists
messages.not_found: Nothing of that name or id exists
messages.not_granted: The grants do not give what is asked
messages.not_permitted: The space does not permit what is asked
messages.not_retiring: The key named is not being retired
messages.overloaded: The implementation is busy for a moment; try again
messages.quota_exceeded: The write would go past the quota
messages.rate_limited: The caller is calling faster than it is let; slow down
messages.read_only: The database is read-only for now
messages.role_refused: The role asked for is not one the caller may hold
messages.size_differs: The size written differs from the size declared
messages.stale: What the call was based on has changed since
messages.still_asked: The binding still asks for capacity
messages.still_running: The deployment is still running; stop it first
messages.storage_full: No store has room for the write now
messages.too_large: The input is larger than its bound
messages.unbound: The binding has not been bound by its host yet
messages.unfetchable: The artifact could not be fetched
messages.unplaceable: No store meets the placement asked for
messages.unreachable: A host or service the call needs could not be reached
messages.unresolved: A handle in the change resolves to nothing
messages.wrong_offset: The write does not start where the upload ends
messages.wrong_type: The bucket is not of the type the call needs

header.kid: the first 16 bytes of the BLAKE3 of the signer's public key
